Meta.tagline: Find your people by what you love.
Meta.description: Najimi turns what you love into a feed, a map of your people, games with friends and plans it books for you, with an AI agent in every chat and Qloo's taste graph underneath.

Landing.title: Find your people by what you love.
Landing.lede: Tell Najimi a few things you love. It reads your taste through Qloo, plays it back as music and culture, shows where your people are, and puts an agent in your chats that plans, plays and books with your friends.
Landing.footer: Najimi, made for the Qloo hackathon.

instagram.1: In Instagram: Profile → ≡ → Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Export your information.
instagram.2: Choose Followers and following, and Likes and saved; pick JSON; request it.
instagram.3: When Instagram emails you (often minutes, up to a day), download the .zip and choose it here.

tiktok.1: In TikTok: Profile → ≡ → Settings and privacy → Account → Download your data.
tiktok.3: When it's ready (in the same screen, a few days at most), download it and choose it here.

spotify.1: On spotify.com: Account → Privacy settings → Download your data.
spotify.2: Request your Account data (not the extended history).
spotify.3: When Spotify emails you, download the .zip and choose it here.

youtube.2: Select YouTube and YouTube Music, then only 'subscriptions'.
youtube.3: Download the .zip when it's ready and choose it here.
